Bowling · 21 scene points · UNITAS-inspired adaptation

Can the tokenizer reconstruct
the Bowling trajectory it already sees?

This UNITAS-inspired sparse adaptation represents ten bowling pins by their top and bottom centers, plus one ball center: 21 scene points. Its tokenizer compresses an entire point trajectory into a latent vector, then decodes it at the original timestamps. These sixteen validation cases expose reconstruction errors before training any dynamics model.

· Separate run and checkpoint; reconstruction coordinates are not mixed.

USES FUTURE GROUND TRUTH · NOT CAUSAL PREDICTION

Future reconstructions encode the complete true future trajectory. Robot-future inputs are the complete nominal robot plan. The right panel is an autoencoder reconstruction, never a forecast. No dynamics overfit, main dynamics training, or test evaluation was launched after the tokenizer gate failed.

Optimization check

Saved-checkpoint CPU audit only; no parameter updates or test data. These activation measurements are not new model results and do not establish learning rate as the unique cause. Read the exact audit JSON.

Group errors and engineering thresholds

Required for each available group: mean trajectory error (ADE) ≤ 1 mm and last-timestamp error (FDE) ≤ 3 mm. These are the experiment's engineering checks, not paper requirements. Past FDE is measured at −0.1 s; future FDE at 2.0 s.

Group counts are point trajectories: each pin contributes two endpoints. A pin is moving if either endpoint exceeds 1 cm displacement from the current anchor. Group errors pool point trajectories and timestamps; they are not episode-macro forecast scores.

What this failure does and does not establish
  • The selected tokenizer checkpoint misses the frozen reconstruction targets. This limits the fitted checkpoint and recipe; it does not establish a model-family capacity limit.
  • A 256-dimensional latent represents at most 60 future XYZ coordinates per point here, so latent dimension counting alone does not establish an information bottleneck.
  • Reconstruction error is not a rigorous lower bound for every downstream dynamics output: another latent could decode differently. Dynamics training was stopped by the engineering gate, not shown to be impossible.
  • Past displacements use current-minus-past; reconstruction correctly subtracts decoded displacements from the current anchor. Coordinates are saved raw. There is no smoothing, endpoint-length enforcement, rigid projection, or truth substitution.
  • No t0 reconstruction was synthesized. The timeline contains exactly the saved timestamps. Robot future is a command-derived, contact-disabled nominal plan, not future executed robot motion.
  • The diagnostic reads train and validation trajectories only. The test split was not loaded, and this page is not the planned 29-case dynamics test viewer.

Evidence: diagnostic report, frozen gate, this run's protocol, complete recorded curves, independent raw-array verification.

中文说明：这是使用未来真值的重建，不是动态预测

右侧 tokenizer 已经看到了完整真实轨迹，再把它编码和解码。因此页面不能用于声称未来预测能力。这是 UNITAS 启发的 Bowling 稀疏适配：场景展示瓶子顶部、底部中心及球心共 21 点；机器人展示 20 个固定查询点。机器人未来输入是名义动作计划，不是未来实测机器人状态。

工程门槛为所有组 ADE ≤ 1 毫米、FDE ≤ 3 毫米。后续小集动力学过拟合、正式动力学训练和测试均未启动。本页展示全部 16 条验证病例，包含场景/机器人、过去/未来四类重建。两侧共享相机和尺度，原始点未做平滑、刚体修正或替换。时间轴严格对应保存的 −1.0…−0.1 秒或 0.1…2.0 秒，没有补造 t0 解码结果。

该结果说明当前 checkpoint 与训练配方的轨迹重建尚未拟合好，不能推出该类架构绝对不行、256 维必然不够，也不能把重建误差当作所有下游动态输出的数学下界。历史符号约定、时间调制与池化条件仍需结合独立诊断分析。所有误差与训练曲线均来自真实运行；没有模型预测替代品。
